interfaces.name: models
interfaces.constraints: Unmodified Models state from the qualified model-fit stage. Average two class-1 score vectors equally. Fit increasing isotonic mapping bounded to [0,1], clipping outside calibration score range; then select the highest observed-score cutoff among equal empirical binary F1 values. Apply score >= cutoff to query rows without refitting text features or base models. Mapping and cutoff use the same calibration rows, so reported selection F1 is not independent accuracy. Returns raw and scaled scores, decisions and selection metrics; no probability-calibration guarantee.

interfaces.name: payload
interfaces.constraints: Exact finite JSON-compatible version-2 request with binary_relevance task and title_description role. Nonempty training, calibration and query record pairs; each record has exactly string title and description fields. Training and calibration labels are integer 0/1 with both classes. Explicit vocabulary, domain substitutions and synonyms; explicit projection, BM25 and forest controls. Text limits and normalized full-record population collision rules apply. No entity-disjointness guarantee. Deep-copies the request; caller must not mutate the resulting payload before the next stage.

limitations: Automated Tier 3 only; no human Tier 1 review or Tier 2 designation.
Recipe adapters carry explicit policy; independently reusable numerical/text primitives retain separate catalog identities.
Concrete execution-local state only; arbitrary fabricated or concurrently mutated intermediate states are unqualified.
Bounds are caller contracts, not a promise to reject every invalid object or finite arithmetic overflow.
Full-record pair-disjoint populations are required; stronger entity/domain separation remains caller-owned.
No named competition accuracy, probability calibration, submission-file compatibility or abstract-witness equivalence claim.
Three semantic cases supplement the source-bound 115-test recipe qualification and three native graph executions.
Exact registered dependency versions and reviewed metadata must be installed before activation.
No adapter or original-CDG approval is performed by this review.
